name: Guest-ly

subtitle.en: Wedding concierge for guests and couples
subtitle.es: Concierge de bodas para invitados y parejas

short_description.en: Your wedding concierge for guests, couples and planners.
short_description.es: Tu concierge de bodas para invitados, parejas y planners.

age_rating: 12+ (as set in App Store Connect: messaging, infrequent or mild alcohol references)

description.en:
Guest-ly is the calm place for every guest and every question at a wedding.

FOR GUESTS
Open your invitation with the code the couple sent you. Find your name, answer for each person and each event, and add everything to your calendar. Ask the concierge anything about the day: parking, hotels, the dress code, the shuttle. Questions only the couple can answer reach them, and their reply lands back in the app. On the wedding day the app tells you where to be right now.

FOR COUPLES
See every RSVP as it arrives, the questions guests are asking, and the few things that need you today. Answer a guest from your phone. Record an RSVP you received in person. On the day, check guests in at the door with a scan, even without signal.

FOR PLANNERS
All your weddings in one place: a Today view across them, guest lists, requests to the couple, tasks and, when the agency allows it, door check-in. Propose a change; the couple approves and it applies itself.

ON YOUR HOME AND LOCK SCREEN
Widgets for the countdown, new replies, today's plan and the wedding day, plus a Live Activity for the day's schedule and the door check-in.

FOR BIG SCREENS
On the iPhone Duo and in any wide window, lists and records sit side by side.

New couples can create their account right in the app and set up their wedding in a minute. Guest-ly is a companion to the wedding service at guest-ly.com. There is nothing to buy in the app.
description.es:
Guest-ly es el lugar en calma para cada invitado y cada pregunta de una boda.

PARA INVITADOS
Abre tu invitación con el código que te envió la pareja. Encuentra tu nombre, responde por cada persona y cada evento, y agrega todo a tu calendario. Pregúntale al concierge lo que quieras sobre el día: estacionamiento, hoteles, vestimenta, el transporte. Las preguntas que solo la pareja puede responder les llegan a ellos, y su respuesta vuelve a la app. El día de la boda, la app te dice dónde tienes que estar ahora mismo.

PARA PAREJAS
Ve cada confirmación en cuanto llega, lo que preguntan los invitados y las pocas cosas que hoy requieren tu atención. Responde a un invitado desde el teléfono. Registra una confirmación que recibiste en persona. El día de la boda, registra a los invitados en la puerta con un escaneo, incluso sin señal.

PARA PLANNERS
Todas tus bodas en un solo lugar: una vista de Hoy entre ellas, listas de invitados, solicitudes a la pareja, tareas y, cuando la agencia lo permite, el check-in en la puerta. Propón un cambio; la pareja lo aprueba y se aplica solo.

EN TU PANTALLA DE INICIO Y DE BLOQUEO
Widgets con la cuenta regresiva, las respuestas nuevas, el plan de hoy y el día de la boda, y una Live Activity con el programa del día y el check-in en la puerta.

PARA PANTALLAS GRANDES
En el iPhone Duo y en cualquier ventana ancha, las listas y los registros van lado a lado.

Las parejas nuevas pueden crear su cuenta directamente en la app y configurar su boda en un minuto. Guest-ly es el complemento del servicio de bodas de guest-ly.com. No hay nada que comprar en la app.

collected.who: couples, planners, guests (name on the guest list)
guests, entered by the couple on the web; shown to couples only
guest questions to the concierge; couple and planner messages to the Coordinator (sent to Anthropic after the in-app permission screen)
couples and planners: website images, the floor plan, budget receipts
guests: each time the guest opens the app, stored against the guest and shown to the couple as Seen (last open and number of visits)

not_collected: Location (no location permission is requested; the app never reads location)
Other Usage Data and Advertising Data (no analytics or ads SDK; the only usage data is the guest app opens listed above)

promotional_text.en: Every guest question answered, every RSVP tracked, one calm app for the whole wedding.
promotional_text.es: Cada pregunta de un invitado respondida, cada confirmación registrada, una sola app en calma para toda la boda.

whats_new.en: Your wedding day, live: see what is happening now and what comes next. Works even with no signal at the venue. Locked timeline with change requests, places with directions, hair and makeup schedule, final guest count, your road to the wedding, and clearer messages when something goes wrong.
whats_new.es: Tu boda en vivo: mira lo que está pasando ahora y lo que viene después. Funciona incluso sin señal en el lugar. Cronograma cerrado con solicitudes de cambio, lugares con cómo llegar, horario de peinado y maquillaje, conteo final de invitados, tu camino a la boda y mensajes más claros cuando algo sale mal.

age_rating_answers.unrestricted_web_access_note: The in-app web view only opens pages on the couple's own guest-ly.com wedding site and portal, fenced by an allow-list (src/features/webview/bridge.ts); it cannot browse the open web.
age_rating_answers.user_generated_content_moderation: Guest and couple text (RSVP notes, concierge questions, messages) is private to that wedding's couple, planner and guests; nothing is public or shown across weddings.

export_compliance.note: Uses only standard iOS networking (HTTPS/TLS); no proprietary or non-exempt encryption. ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption is already false in app.config.ts.

review_notes_en:
Guest-ly is the free companion app to a wedding service couples set up at guest-ly.com. Couples can also create their account in the app; planner accounts are created by their agency. The app has no In-App Purchase, subscription or price.

DEMO WEDDING (all data fictional): Camila & Andrés, 21 March 2027.
GUEST: tap "Open my invitation", enter code CAMAND, type Whit and pick Whitney Adler, then allow notifications or tap Not now. You can RSVP, read the schedule, ask the Concierge (try the Dress code chip) and open the day-of screen.
COUPLE: on the entrance tap "I'm the couple or the planner" and sign in with review@guest-ly.com (password in the Sign-in information fields). Tabs: Home, Guests, Guest Messages (Conversations / Broadcasts switch), Coordinator and Tools (wedding site, budget, tasks, seating, door check-in). Settings is the gear on Home and the last row of Tools. Sign in with Apple and Google are offered next to the emailed link.

AI: the guest Concierge and the couple/planner Coordinator are AI features, labelled as AI. Questions the AI cannot answer go to the couple; nothing is guessed. Before a couple or planner first sends anything to the Coordinator, a permission screen names Anthropic (Claude API), says what is sent (their messages and the wedding details the chat reads to answer) and why, with "Allow and continue" and "Not now"; "Not now" sends nothing (guideline 5.1.2(i)). Services: Anthropic (Claude API) for the AI, Supabase for database and sign-in, Resend for email, Netlify for the backend, Expo push for optional notifications, and a backend we operate for opt-in WhatsApp messages (WhatsApp Business API). No payment processor is integrated.
CAMERA: only to scan a guest's QR pass at door check-in and, for couples and planners, to photograph a floor plan or a receipt. No audio or video is recorded. NOTIFICATIONS are optional.
ACCOUNT DELETION: Settings > Delete account deletes the account immediately. The shared demo logins are protected so every reviewer can use them; to test deletion, create an account with "Getting married? Create your account".
PLANS are sold only on the web. On the United States storefront only, the locked home of a new account shows "Choose your plan", which opens guest-ly.com in Safari (guideline 3.1.1(a)). On every other storefront the app shows no price, purchase wording or link.

NEW IN 1.2
LAYOUT: Home, Guests, Guest Messages, Coordinator, Tools. Broadcasts (WhatsApp announcements from approved templates) live in Guest Messages; the demo wedding is a simulation, nothing is delivered to any phone. "Request a template" goes to Guest-ly staff and sends nothing to guests.
COORDINATOR TAB: AI chat for the couple. On a wedding without it, the tab shows examples and an email button, never a price.
EMAILED SIGN-IN: a link that opens the app plus an 8-digit code usable on any device.
WIDGETS AND LIVE ACTIVITIES (countdown, replies, today, weddings, day-of; wedding-day schedule, door check-in): they show data the app already holds, make no network requests and need no extra permission. Live Activities update only while the app is open; no push token is collected.
WIDE SCREENS (iPhone Duo inner display, outer display sideways, split window): lists and records sit side by side. Other iPhones are unchanged.
DOOR CHECK-IN: couples, and planners granted the Check-in tool, can check guests in. On an iPhone Duo an optional welcome ("Welcome, <name>. Table <n>") can face the guest on the outer display; it has an off switch on the same screen.
PLANNER TOOLS: Today, Weddings, Check-in and Messages (read-only). Check-in and Messages work only when the agency grants them for a wedding, so they are locked by default. Planners never receive a guest's phone or email through them. A planner demo login is available on request through the contact details above.
INVITATION: on an iPhone Duo the guest's invitation opens like an envelope as the phone opens; a tap, or Reduce Motion, opens it without animation.
IPAD: iPhone-only app; it runs in the iPhone compatibility window on iPad.

NEW IN 1.4
WEDDING-DAY SCREENS: on the wedding day, Tools > Day-of shows Now and Next with the minutes left and Mark done, and the day's runsheet, guest list and door search are saved on the phone so they work without signal. A normal day shows the day's plan only. To see the wedding-day screens on any day, the demo wedding's Day-of screen has "Preview the day": pick a moment of the day and the screen runs as it would at that time, with a banner saying it is a preview. Nothing done in the preview is saved. This control exists only on demo weddings.
COORDINATOR PLANS: one message can produce one card with several changes (for example add a task, a vendor and a budget line), shown as a checklist. Nothing changes until the person taps "Run N actions"; any line can be unticked first; a line the plan added can be undone for 30 minutes. Sends to guests are never part of a plan and keep their own typed confirmation.
RATINGS: after the wedding day, the couple's Home can show a "Your feedback" card. Any of its five ratings opens our own feedback page in the in-app browser, the same page for every rating. When that page is closed, the app may ask iOS once per install for Apple's own rating prompt (SKStoreReviewController); iOS decides whether it shows. Nothing is offered for a rating. The demo wedding is before its date, so the card does not show there.
Other 1.4 additions are wedding planning screens that show data the couple or planner already entered on the web (timeline lock and change requests, places with Apple Maps and Google Maps links that open those apps, final guest count, a know-before-you-go card, "Seen" status, a road-to-the-wedding card). None of them needs a new permission.
credentials_location: The review password is stored in App Store Connect (App Review Information, carried over from 1.1.0). The couple login is review@guest-ly.com. The planner demo login (planner-review@guest-ly.com, password in guestly-mobile/credentials/demo-accounts.env key PART9_PLANNER_PASSWORD) is deliberately NOT in the notes; it is offered on request. That file is gitignored and never printed by any script.
helpful_details_en: Guest-ly is optimized for the iPhone Duo: lists and records sit side by side on the inner display and on the outer display held sideways, the door check-in and the wedding-day screen rearrange when the phone is half-open, and widgets and Live Activities keep the countdown and the day's schedule in view.
helpful_details_es: Guest-ly está optimizada para el iPhone Duo: las listas y los registros van lado a lado en la pantalla interior y en la exterior en horizontal, el check-in en la puerta y la pantalla del día de la boda se reorganizan con el teléfono medio abierto, y los widgets y Live Activities mantienen a la vista la cuenta regresiva y el programa del día.
